name: Bunni
source:
Bunni Rheiner is the other half of the malicious time-travelling team known as Chrontek. Together with Mizuki, she's working under the orders of a mysterious higher power to alter the very flow of time!

Bunni's from the USA and she's fairly tall at 5'11. Her beautifully long, purple hair is very often seen paired with a set of bunny ears, as suits her name, with matching cuffs, tube top, shorts and bow tie. What a smartly dressed lady! But don't let her playful tricks seduce you - even though she's not carrying any weapons, her legs are where her strengths lie, and she knows how to use them in a fight!

She enjoys cocktails when she's going out, and she's also a keen gymnast, something that helps to keep her long legs flexible and in shape. Like Mizuki, she has two ingame outfits; her Time Suit, which you can see here, and a more casual outfit for less intense situations.

"How much further, Mizuki? The Commander was pretty clear that she wants us to be in and out as fast as possible!"

Let's give it our all in the final stretch, guys! We're nearly there!

- From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/silvercow/time-tenshi-time-travelling-anime-visual-novel/posts/2745595]Time Tenshi Kickstarter update #7[/url]
